review.rationale: The claim makes an unsupported assertion about participant experience. The provided evidence does not support a generalized rupture in selfhood and social order.

retrieved_rules.detection_check: Locate the assertion and test its evidence-to-claim warrant.
retrieved_rules.evidence_requirement: Identify relevant exact passages or an explicit whole-packet missing warrant.
retrieved_rules.countercondition: A defensible alternative interpretation alone is not a flaw.

retrieved_rules.applicability: Attribution, scope, causal or aggregate claims
retrieved_rules.detection_check: Check speaker, scope, negation, uncertainty and consequential countercases.
retrieved_rules.evidence_requirement: Compare each relevant account under its actual stated conditions.
retrieved_rules.countercondition: Do not infer missing context or the opposite of an unsupported assertion.
